reels.title: “I Am Afraid for Our Future”: Is Europe Heading Toward a Civil War?
reels.hook: Is Europe heading toward a civil war?
reels.why: Strong personal emotion and an alarming claim by a British scholar. Concludes with a well-rounded thought about a polarized society in which people jump at each other's throats.
reels.speaker: Jadranka Polović
reels.quote: I am honestly afraid for our future.

cards.text: Is Europe heading toward a civil war?

“I am honestly afraid for our future.”

“The European Union is heading toward a civil war.”
“People are jumping at each other's throats.”

reels.title: The Happiest Country Is the One Where You Don't Know Who Your Prime Minister Is
